title: KAT5 Acetylates Human Chromatin Protein PC4 to promote DNA Repair
authors: Sweta Sikder; Aayushi Agrawal; Siddharth Singh; Ramalingam Peraman; Viswanathan Ravichandran; Tapas K. Kundu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究KAT5乙酰化染色质蛋白PC4促进DNA修复，涉及PC4与DNA结合及损伤修复机制，但核心是乙酰化修饰而非TF-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Human positive coactivator 4 (PC4), is a highly abundant non-histone chromatin protein involved in diverse cellular processes, including transcription regulation, genome organization, DNA repair, etc. The majority of PC4 exists in a phosphorylated state in cells, which impinges its acetylation by p300 and thereby inhibits its double-stranded DNA binding ability and transcriptional co-activator function. Recently, we have shown that PC4 interacts with linker histone H1 in its phosphorylated state, and this interaction is important for PC4- mediated chromatin compaction. PC4 was also found to be an activator of non-homologous end joining and DSB repair activity. Knockdown of PC4 causes drastic decompaction and enhanced autophagy in the cells. Mechanistically, in the absence of PC4, the genome becomes highly vulnerable to DNA damage with an altered epigenetic landscape. Here, we report that other than p300, PC4 also gets acetylated by DNA repair facilitating lysine acetyltransferase KAT5 (Tip60), at K80 residue when the cells are subjected to DNA damage. The vulnerability of DNA in PC4 devoid cells could be substantially reduced by reintroducing wild-type PC4 to the cells but not the mutant PC4 (K80R PC4), defective in KAT5-mediated acetylation. Presumably, KAT5-mediated acetylation of PC4 at K80 residue facilitates the DNA repair machinery at the damage site and thus contributes to DNA damage repair, a process that could be of high significance both in cancer and in aging.
abstract_zh: 人源正共激活因子4（PC4）是一种高丰度的非组蛋白染色质蛋白，参与多种细胞过程，包括转录调控、基因组组织、DNA修复等。细胞中大部分PC4以磷酸化状态存在，这影响其被p300乙酰化，从而抑制其双链DNA结合能力和转录共激活功能。近期，我们已证明PC4在其磷酸化状态下与连接组蛋白H1相互作用，且此相互作用对PC4介导的染色质压缩至关重要。PC4还被发现是非同源末端连接和DSB修复活性的激活因子。PC4的敲低导致细胞中染色质显著去压缩和自噬增强。机制上，在缺乏PC4的情况下，基因组变得高度易受DNA损伤影响，并伴随表观遗传景观的改变。在此，我们报告，除p300外，当细胞遭受DNA损伤时，PC4还会在K80残基处被DNA修复促进性赖氨酸乙酰转移酶KAT5（Tip60）乙酰化。通过向缺乏PC4的细胞重新引入野生型PC4，可显著降低DNA的易损性，但引入在KAT5介导的乙酰化中缺陷的突变体PC4（K80R PC4）则无此效果。推测KAT5介导的PC4在K80残基处的乙酰化促进了损伤位点的DNA修复机制，从而有助于DNA损伤修复，这一过程在癌症和衰老中可能具有重要意义。
